description.en: Other memory plugins help your agent remember more. This one decides what is allowed to count: agents propose, a human approves (three-store gate + immutable audit log), and recall runs on SQLite FTS5/BM25 with zero model calls (measured p50 2.3ms). A token ledger shows what recall actually cost. One vault for DSH, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes, MengBot and any MCP client. v0.31 adds five one-click skins (Default, Pop, Light, Resident Evil, Spider-Man) with full-bleed theme banners and per-skin hover contrast.

description.en: Tag-based long-term memory for dsh agents: entries live in a plain 9-column CSV that can be opened and edited by hand, with three JSONL ledgers recording every write, read and tidy, plus an automatic backup before any library change. Project and agent are filled by the program from the session working directory and the bound identity, so the model only decides free tags and must ask the user for a name on first use in an unbound session. Recall hard-filters on project, agent and status before scoring, so other agents entries are invisible by isolation rather than by low score, then applies two vetoes (entry ratio above 0.5, query ratio at least 0.15) so a passing score still cannot return noise. A stability ladder promotes an entry to stable only after three verified uses with no wrong answer, and any wrong demotes it to volatile. 10 tools, a web UI for browsing and editing, no network calls, no embeddings, no API keys.
description.zh: 给 dsh 智能体的标签化长期记忆：条目存在一份可直接用编辑器打开修改的 9 列 CSV 里，写入、读取、整理三本 JSONL 台账记录每一次操作，改库前自动备份。项目与智能体由程序从会话工作目录和已绑定身份填充，模型只决定自由标签，未绑定身份的会话首次使用时必须向用户询问名字。召回先按项目、智能体、状态硬筛再打分，跨智能体条目靠隔离不可见而非分数低，另有两道否决（条目命中率须大于 0.5、query 命中率须不低于 0.15），过线也不会返回噪声。稳定性阶梯需三次验证通过且无错答才升为稳定，出现错答即降为易变。10 个工具、可浏览与编辑的网页界面，无网络请求、无向量、无 API 密钥。

description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 代理预设：把任务分为快速、标准、深入三档，内置 22 个技能覆盖需求追问、写规格、拆工单、实现、评审、验证与交接，并带轮次守卫——改完必须给出真实验证证据，同一修法失败两次就停下重新核对前提。

description.en: Durable background task templates for DSH: define a task as one to ten ordered steps, then run it by hand or from a native Schedule entry. Steps are executed by the calling agent in its own authorized context - there is no resident worker. Each execution becomes its own TaskRun with a frozen template snapshot, persisted per-step status and progress, a heartbeat and execution token, a failure record naming the failing step, and a queryable run history. Failed, interrupted and blocked runs are recovered by creating a new run that carries completed steps over and resumes at the first unfinished one; a step that may have produced side effects needs explicit confirmation before retry, and records that cannot be proven finished are never replayed automatically. Records live in a StorageDomain rather than memory, so they survive restart; a duplicated schedule delivery cannot start a second execution, and overlapping runs are bounded per task and per Session. Verified on DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 (desktop) with Node 22+; scheduling uses the host native Schedule and is unavailable when that service is not mounted, while manual runs keep working. Tasks are private to the Session that created them; the board UI is meant for a single local user and does not claim multi-user isolation, because the host does not authenticate plugin HTTP routes. Registers 14 task_* tools and reuses the host schedule, agent and tool permissions instead of replacing them. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 的可复用后台任务模板：把任务写成 1 到 10 个有序步骤，既可以手动执行，也可以挂到原生定时任务上。步骤由调用方 Agent 在它自己的授权上下文里执行，不存在常驻 Worker。每次执行都是一条独立的 TaskRun，带冻结的模板快照、持久化的步骤状态与进度、心跳与执行凭证、记录失败步骤的错误信息，以及可查询的运行历史。失败、中断、阻塞的运行通过新建一次运行来恢复，已完成步骤会结转、从第一个未完成步骤继续；可能有副作用的步骤必须先由用户确认才能重试，无法确认结果时绝不自动重放。记录存放在 StorageDomain 而不是内存里，重启后仍在；同一时间点的重复定时投递不会重复启动，并发按任务与会话双重限额。已在 DSH 0.2.2-rc.3（桌面版）与 Node 22+ 上验证；定时复用宿主原生 Schedule，未挂载该服务时定时不可用而手动执行照常。任务只对创建它的会话可见；看板按本机单用户设计，不宣称多用户隔离，因为宿主不对插件的 HTTP 路由做认证。注册 14 个 task_* 工具，复用宿主既有的调度、Agent 与工具权限。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Compute a figure's printed font size from your page's text width before you export it, then verify three things per file — printed size, effective resolution, and pixel width — and pick a chart type that matches the message. Ships a style module, a read-only verifier, an overlap audit, CFD panel conventions, and 19 reproducible recipes rendered from synthetic data.
description.zh: 出图前按正文宽度反算印刷字号，落盘后逐张验收印刷字号、有效分辨率与像素宽三项，并按表达意图选图型。自带样式模块、只读验收器、压盖检查、CFD 云图范式，以及 19 个用合成数据渲染的可复现配方。

Also applies one deep-blue theme token layer plus a generated starfield, and uninstalling restores the original UI exactly.
description.zh: 深蓝驾驶舱 HUD：右下角可折叠面板显示会话经济（入/出 token、平滑 tok/s、上下文占用与阈值色）；接管 assistant-step 渲染器把思考逐字打出、思考块可折叠、工具调用可展开，正文走自建 Markdown 渲染器；另有数据流弹窗（token 节奏柱、上下文曲线、思考与执行流）。同时用一层 theme token 把整套界面切成深蓝并铺星空，卸载即完全还原。

description.en: A PyFluent operating procedure for ANSYS Fluent on Windows, distilled from real production runs: startup handshake, setup order, session state-machine traps, time-step and Courant judgement, long runs with checkpoint and resume, VOF, multiphase and non-Newtonian setups, UDS plus UDF compilation, result reading from .dat.h5, and twelve environment traps with the exact error strings that precede them.
description.zh: Windows 下的 PyFluent 实操规程，来自真实生产算例：启动握手、设置顺序、会话状态机陷阱、时间步与 Courant 判定、长跑与断点续算、VOF 与多相及非牛顿设置、UDS 与 UDF 编译、.dat.h5 结果读取，以及十二条环境坑与它们的原始报错。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar and home hero branding with one of 13 AI product logo presets, a custom SVG/image and label, or nothing at all, with separate toggles for the sidebar mark, the hero mark, the blank-home whale animation and monochrome icons.
description.zh: 把侧边栏与首页标题的品牌标识换成 13 款 AI 产品 Logo 预设、自定义 SVG/图片与文字，或完全隐藏，并可分别控制侧边栏图标、首页图标、空白首页鲸鱼动画与单色图标。

description.en: Enhanced fork of ZSeven-W/dsh-crew for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: adds opt-in persistent sessions, atomic hub.json port discovery, visual provider/model bindings with route probe, 4-tier per-task permissions with Windows auto-worktree fallback, and threshold report offloading across 8 MCP tools. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: ZSeven-W/dsh-crew 的增强分支，面向 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity 与 Grok 提供 8 个 MCP 工具：新增可选持久会话、hub.json 动态端口发现、可视化模型路由与连通性探测、4 档逐任务权限及 Windows 自动 Worktree 降级，以及阈值报告落档。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: D-01 suite: market board + quant machine as DeepSeek Harness plugins
description.zh: 装一次就有 A股行情看板和量化交易面板，看盘、分析、下单一条龙。

description.en: Manager and sub threads for DeepSeek Harness: bidirectional thread messaging, live statuses, and side-panel thread conversations.
description.zh: 把对话变成线程树，主会话当管理者派活给子线程，还能双向收发消息、实时看状态。

description.en: Personal fork of dsh-TUI — a terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness, with local patches.
DeepSeek Harness外观插件，将你的DeepSeek改造成mc主题的界面。
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的网页界面换成 Minecraft 方块风，草地、箱子、镐子全都有，推理等级还用矿石来显示。

description.en: Replaces the sidebar account avatar with your own picture: upload, crop, and it is stored on this machine. The account menu, sign-in and notifications stay untouched.
description.zh: 把侧边栏账号头像换成自己上传的图片，还能自定义昵称，图片只存在本机。

description.en: A standalone sci-fi dashboard for the official automation tasks: task status cards, a top readout bar (fired today, on-time delivery rate, next-run countdown) and a delivery-record timeline. Read only — every value comes from the official schedule service, and the Automation tasks page is left untouched.
DSH Web 左侧栏百炼花费面板：本地会话 token 统计、300 元额度估算与校准
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 左侧栏显示百炼花费，按本地会话统计 token，估算 300 元额度并支持校准。

description.en: DSH插件：对话导出与截图，导出 Markdown、TXT、JSON、CSV、PNG 和 PDF，选择消息生成高清截图。
description.zh: 把对话按消息挑着导出成 Markdown、TXT、JSON、CSV、PNG、PDF，还能生成高清截图。

description.en: 适配 DSH 的猪齿鱼插件：账号、项目、任务看板与项目模型接入
description.zh: 把猪齿鱼账号、项目、任务看板和项目模型接进 DSH，左侧面板直接管项目任务。

description.en: 把本机登录的豆包工作接入 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器：倍率由上游目录给出，逐模型图片输入开关、账号池自动换号、只读积分胶囊。Doubao Work models for DSH.
description.zh: 把本机登录的豆包工作接进 DSH 模型选择器，支持多账号自动换号和积分倍率显示。

description.en: DSH 模型菜单里的 Codex 风格推理等级滑条（重绘自 dsh-codex-power-slider）
description.zh: 在模型菜单里加一条 Codex 风格推理等级滑条，拖动即可连续调节推理强度，颜色和动效随档位实时变化。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 事件预测与产业链因果推演插件（4+1 靶向红蓝对抗）| Evidence-grounded industry-chain event impact plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 先锁定事实底稿，再用4+1红蓝对抗推演事件对产业链的冲击，辅助投资研究判断。

description.en: DSH 界面右下角的 Gemini娘：上下文占用 / Token / 缓存命中率 / 余额 / 每轮消耗，五帧表情联动、确认提醒、轮末播报
description.zh: 在 DSH 界面右下角养一只 Gemini 娘，实时显示上下文占用、Token、缓存命中率和余额，表情还会跟着会话状态变。

description.en: Save, switch, and pause global instruction profiles in DeepSeek Harness (DSH). 多套全局指令，一键切换与暂停。
description.zh: 给 DSH 存多套全局指令，一键切换或暂停，不用反复改配置。

description.en: HALOFLUX by Ryder191 as a live DSH session dashboard. Noncommercial use only.
description.zh: 在侧栏开个光环任务台，实时看正在跑、等确认和刚完成的会话，一键切回去。

description.en: 免费生图｜DeepSeek Harness 侧栏插件，硅基流动 Kolors，多 Key 池 + 额度控制 + 历史回收站。Free Kolors image generation with key pool and quotas.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏用硅基流动免费额度一键生成 Kolors 图片，自动存本地并管理历史与回收站。

description.en: Root-session Leader contract for DeepSeek Harness: orchestrate, delegate to subagents, audit.
description.zh: 给主会话注入 Leader 契约，让主智能体负责规划、拆分任务、派发子智能体并审计结果。

description.en: Teach you learn sth util you really understand.
Math symbol palette for the DSH composer: click-to-insert, editable draft, operators, LaTeX.
description.zh: 输入框旁的数学符号面板，点选符号、编辑草稿，确认后插入光标处，写公式更省事。

description.en: 🎵 Windows Media-key control for DSH: play/pause, stop, previous, next, mute, volume up/down through Windows media keys. | 为DSH设计的Windows媒体操作工具
description.zh: 让 AI 助手直接按 Windows 媒体键，一句话就能播放/暂停、切歌、静音和调音量。

description.en: 纯文本通用记忆架构：常驻层不到 2KB，记忆永久存档，可随时迁移。适用于各类能读文件的 AI Agent，提供 DSH 插件与纯文件双版本。 | Ultra-lightweight plain-text memory architecture: <2KB resident layer, persistent archives, portable anytime. For file-capable AI agents; DSH plugin and plain-file editions.
description.zh: 给 AI Agent 加一套轻量分层记忆，常驻不到 2KB，记忆永久存档、随时迁移。

description.en: Naiwa persona, art direction and Web GUI controls for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 会话加上奶蛙口吻，还能在 Web 面板切换人格、皮肤和提示音。

description.en: 在你闲暇的时候，带领你的大肥鱼来一场紧张刺激的贪吃蛇游戏，躲避重重障碍，吃到token/白米饭
description.zh: 一只住在 Windows 桌面上的鲸鱼娘桌宠，闲下来就变成贪吃蛇追着光标吃 token，你一敲键盘她就安静退场。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏提示词模板库：分类、变量、收藏，一键带入会话。 / Sidebar prompt templates with categories, variables, favorites, and one-click insert into chat.
description.zh: 侧栏提示词模板库，分类收藏加变量，一键把常用提示词带进对话，省得反复手打。

description.en: 把「生产级配置」挡在 agent 的工具之外：按分组登记不允许被读取、搜索或写入的目录与文件，DeepSeek Harness 会在工具真正执行之前拒绝任何触碰它们的调用。
Manage a QQ mailbox from DSH: read, search, archive by rule, mark read, deduplicate, and send — over IMAP/SMTP with a dependency-free client.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里直接管理 QQ 邮箱，收发、搜索、按规则归档、去重都能搞定。

description.en: Daily Apple App Store and Google Play rankings for 17 countries, with weekly, monthly and rising charts, game charts and one-line Chinese intros.
description.zh: 支持 17 个国家/地区的苹果 App Store 与谷歌 Play 榜单：日榜、周榜、月榜、飙升榜与游戏榜，每款一句话中文简介，侧栏直接看。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把当前会话讨论压缩后发送到任意工作区的另一个会话继续执行
description.zh: 把当前会话的讨论压缩打包，一键发到另一个工作区的会话里接着干，不用手动复制粘贴。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 注意力会话收件箱插件：保留原生侧栏框架，支持多工作区筛选与反选、运行中悬浮卡片和精准状态识别。
description.zh: 把 DSH 侧栏改造成会话收件箱，支持多工作区筛选、运行状态识别和悬浮卡片，帮你快速盯住该看的会话。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏的黏土质感 3D 图标主题：21 个项目文件夹 + 28 个会话图标，按名称自动匹配、也可逐行自定义，会话相对项目缩进成层级。Claymorphism 3D icon theme for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar: 21 clay folders for projects, 28 clay objects for sessions — matched from names, overridable per row, with hierarchy indentation.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏换上黏土风 3D 图标，项目文件夹和会话自动匹配，也能逐行自定义。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle that refuses shell commands that would block the whole turn.
description.zh: 自动拦截会卡住整轮对话的 shell 命令，避免 agent 因等待而空转。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 冷启动动画 + 毛玻璃皮肤插件（ELISA · FLOW 0.6.1）：黑幕开幕 / HUD 冷启动 / 交接转场 / 程序化音轨 / 四档皮肤；完整素材开源版（v0.6.1：人物视频/海报/图层 16 文件随仓库发布）
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一套冷启动开场动画和毛玻璃皮肤，启动更有仪式感，还能换四档主题。

description.en: Rewrite DSH's native token usage pill units to 亿/百万 while preserving the click-to-open dialog.
description.zh: 把 DSH 原生 token 用量读数换成中文单位（亿/百万），点击明细照常打开。

description.en: Read-only DSH sidebar listing every Git worktree on the machine by repository, with status, inline diffs and matching Codex / ZCode / DSH sessions; fetch, pull, push and AI code review only on request.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏只读总览本机的全部 Git 工作树，按仓库分组：状态、未推送和落后数、未提交与未推送改动的就地差异、本地分支，以及匹配到的 Codex / ZCode / DSH 会话；获取、拉取、推送和 AI 代码审查都只在你触发之后才执行。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 的提示词装载自检 + provider 档案（profile 声明层，只读观测，现场三断言）/ Prompt-loading self-check + provider profiles for DSH
description.zh: 给 DSH 做提示词装载自检和各家 provider 差异档案，只读观测不改宿主，装完能现场验证。

description.en: Agent-friendly browser control: attach to the Chrome you are already signed in to, snapshot pages into ref handles, assert each action, and switch into cross-origin iframes.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的浏览器操作：附着你已经登录的 Chrome、把页面扫成 ref 引用、每个动作都能断言结果，并可切进跨域 iframe 操作。

description.en: Preview and import local Codex conversations into DeepSeek Harness, browse their history, and continue chatting in DSH.
description.zh: 预览本机 Codex 对话并导入 DeepSeek Harness，在 DSH 中查看历史、继续对话。

description.en: Personal workbench for appraisal workflows: project and timesheet tracking, Tianyuan system integration (MCP/CLI), a floating assistant that queries Tianyuan via read-only MCP tools, and detail/declare table export with formula restore and print formatting.
description.zh: 评估业务个人工作台：项目与工时管理、天源系统对接（MCP/CLI）、浮动助手（经只读 MCP 工具直查天源数据）、明细表/申报表导出（含公式恢复与打印格式设置）。

description.en: Manage this DSH profile's MCP servers from Settings: add, edit, delete, enable, disable, probe and restart stdio or Streamable HTTP servers; inspect statically composed client rows; import configs from other MCP clients; optional sidebar shortcut. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 统一管理当前 DSH 中的 MCP 服务器：对 stdio 或 Streamable HTTP 服务器做新增、修改、删除、热启停、探测和重启，查看静态接入行，可读取其他agent工具中的 MCP 客户端导入配置，并可选地在左侧栏添加快捷入口。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Mandatory cross-review for design proposals and lessons-learned: auto-detects design doc writes and enqueues them (tier=review) into the task queue, delivers the external reviewer verdict back to the initiating session, and appends approved preventive measures to OPS-GUARDRAILS.md (append-only, conflict-checked).
description.zh: 设计方案与事故教训强制交叉评审：自动识别设计文档写入并入队（tier=review），外部评审结论投递回发起会话，approved 的防复发措施以 append-only + 冲突检测方式追加到守则文件。

description.en: Adds quick replies and next-step cards to chat, with a new-session option only when you need to choose where a task runs.
description.zh: 在聊天中提供快捷回复和下一步建议卡片，只在需要选择任务在哪个会话执行时提供新会话选项。

description.en: Adds the qwen.ai subscription to DeepSeek Harness as a qwen model provider (qwen4-max, qwen3.8-max, qwen3.8-flash): OAuth device-flow sign-in from the settings card, a failover pool of several accounts with per-account quota and usage counters, and streaming chat with tool calling and image input.
description.zh: 把 qwen.ai 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为 qwen 模型提供方（qwen4-max、qwen3.8-max、qwen3.8-flash）：在设置页用 OAuth 设备码登录，多个账号组成故障转移池并按账号统计额度与用量，对话为流式并支持工具调用与图片输入。

description.en: Auditable long-term memory for DSH: memories, decisions and prompt versions in one append-only NDJSON, the last five human turns are never compacted, and every write, recall and compaction can be traced back to its source. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的可审计长期记忆：把记忆、决策和提示版本写进同一个只追加的 NDJSON 文件；最近 5 个真人回合不参与压缩；写入、召回、压缩都能追溯到来源并随时改。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Select text in an AI reply, mark it 👍 or write a 🤔 comment, and send each comment as a composer tag.
description.zh: 框选 AI 回复中的文字，用 👍 认可或写 🤔 评论，并把评论作为输入框 tag 随消息发送。

description.en: Chrome page bridge for DeepSeek Harness: eight browser_* tools read DOM elements, click, type and navigate through a token-paired extension over a loopback WebSocket, so the model works on page text instead of screenshots and no DevTools port is opened.
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接读 Chrome 页面：通过令牌配对的扩展在本地回环 WebSocket 上提供 8 个 browser_* 工具，按选择器或文本读元素、点击、填表、跳转，不截图，也不打开 DevTools 端口。

description.en: A pixel whale on the Windows taskbar showing how many dsh sessions are working, red and blinking when a dialog waits for you.
description.zh: Windows 任务栏上的一只像素鲸鱼，显示正在干活的 dsh 会话数；有弹窗等你确认时变红闪动。

description.en: Detect conflicts between installed skills: group them by capability and separate compatible overlap from real conflicts.
description.zh: 检测已安装 skill 之间的冲突：按能力分组，区分「同类型但不冲突」与「互相冲突」。

description.en: Permanently deletes a Session from the sidebar: the row archive button becomes a delete action with an in-app confirmation, and the Host stops live work then removes the saved history after checking the directory belongs only to that Session.
description.zh: 从侧边栏永久删除会话：把会话行上的归档按钮换成删除操作，弹窗内二次确认后由 Host 停止运行中的工作，校验目录只属于该会话，再删除其保存的记录。

description.en: Reviews research and everyday task answers against user instructions, tool results and delivered files, with quoted evidence beneath each answer.
description.zh: 对照用户要求、工具执行记录和交付文件，审查科研与日常任务的回答，并在原回答下展示问题和证据原文。

description.en: Per-mode persona control for DeepSeek Harness: one shared role library, and each mode either follows the current role or uses its own character card or prompt, injecting no persona text when neither is set.
description.zh: 按模式控制角色设定的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：一份共享角色库，每个模式要么跟随当前角色，要么使用自己的角色卡或提示词；两者都没设置时完全不注入角色文本。

description.en: Adds a Restart button beside the 应用 / 编辑 caption menu in DeepSeek Harness Desktop: one click closes the whole app and brings it back, with no tray icon hunt and no console window flash. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版左上角「应用 / 编辑」旁加一枚「重启」按钮，一键重启整个应用，免去关窗、找托盘、重新打开的麻烦。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A sidebar switchboard for the skills you own: list them, flip model or user invocation on and off, search the bodies, check and one-click fix spec problems, edit SKILL.md, import a folder or zip, move a skill between roots, tag it, and restore anything you deleted. Toggles are written back to the skill frontmatter and picked up without a restart.
description.zh: 左侧栏的技能开关台：列出你自己装的技能，逐个拨动「模型调用 / 用户调用」，全文搜索技能正文，按规范检查并一键修复，直接编辑 SKILL.md，导入文件夹或 zip，在用户/通用/项目三个根之间移动，打标签，删除后还能从回收站恢复。开关写回技能 frontmatter，无需重启即生效。

description.en: Computer Use for a Wayland Linux desktop: screenshots through the XDG desktop portal, the AT-SPI accessibility tree, and pointer and keyboard events written straight to /dev/uinput, exposed to the model as mcp__linux__* tools together with clipboard, process, gsettings and notification helpers, plus a host-side doctor tool and an opt-in AI unlock switch that is off by default.
description.zh: 让 DSH 接管 Wayland Linux 桌面：经 XDG 桌面 portal 截屏、读取 AT-SPI 无障碍树、把鼠标键盘事件直接写入 /dev/uinput，并以 mcp__linux__* 工具连同剪贴板、进程、gsettings 与通知一起交给模型，附带宿主机诊断工具和默认关闭的可选解锁开关。

description.en: Shape-aware tool-output budget for DeepSeek Harness: git status/log/diff, listings, search matches and package-manager noise are digested before they reach the model, the full text stays one read away through the spill store, and failures are never truncated.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的工具输出做按形状的预算：git status/log/diff、目录列表、搜索命中与包管理器噪音在进入模型前被摘要，完整原文一条 read 就能从 spill 取回，错误输出永不裁剪。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the MCP server built into JetBrains Rider, adding a per-session project picker, a connection badge and the mcp__rider__* tools. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 JetBrains Rider 内置的 MCP server，并给每个会话一个项目选择器、一个连接徽标和 mcp__rider__* 工具。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A design-pass agent preset for DeepSeek Harness — picks one visual direction instead of asking, binds a 56-token contract, ships 152 design systems, and exports the finished page to PDF/PNG.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的设计模式 agent 预设——自己选定视觉方向而不是追问，绑定 56 个 token 的契约，内置 152 套设计系统，并把成品导出为 PDF/PNG。

description.en: Select or point at any English word in a DSH conversation and right-click to see its Chinese meaning in a card, without copying it elsewhere. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里选中或指向任意英文单词，右键直接弹出「翻译成中文」卡片，中文释义就地显示，不用复制出去查。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Per-session task panel opened from the conversation header: lists the files attached to this conversation and the file references it mentions, the skills it used with their descriptions, the MCP connectors with their live connection status, and the files it delivered. Images preview inline, and file rows open in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏加任务面板，按当前会话汇总：这次对话的附件与提到的文件引用、用到的技能及其说明、MCP 连接器及实时连接状态、以及交付的文件。图片可就地预览，文件可在右侧栏打开。

description.en: Vertical next-reply suggestions under each completed turn: the reply itself ends with up to three suggested follow-ups, so no auxiliary model call is made. Clicking a suggestion inserts it into the composer at the caret; a paper-plane button sends it, a bubble button inserts it.
description.zh: 每条回答结束后，在本轮下方显示最多 3 条竖排的下一步建议：建议由主回复自身给出，不额外调用模型。点建议文字会插入输入框光标处；纸飞机按钮直接发送，气泡按钮插入输入框。

description.en: Adds two amounts to each finished answer's action row — that turn's cost and this conversation's running total — priced per turn from that turn's own provider-reported usage, with the model route and DeepSeek's current peak/off-peak prices taken from the same log.
description.zh: 在每条回答的操作行里显示本轮花费与本次对话累计金额，按每轮自己上报的用量计价，模型路由与 DeepSeek 官方现行峰谷价都取自该轮自己的日志。

description.en: Adds a WeChat assistant panel to the DSH sidebar that rebuilds the bot's WeChat conversations from the local session store, with search, copy and draft support, and hands plain text to @xmanrui/dsh-im for delivery when a target is already saved.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏加一个「微信助理」面板，从本机会话库还原机器人收到的微信对话，可搜索、复制和写草稿，装有 @xmanrui/dsh-im 且保存过投递目标时可把纯文字交给它发出。

description.en: Espressif ESP32 and ESP8266 development skill for DeepSeek Harness, built from 41 SDK repositories with 554 scenario recipes plus API, configuration and pitfall references.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 ESP32 / ESP8266 开发技能，基于 41 个 Espressif SDK 仓库，含 554 个场景 recipe 与 API、配置、陷阱参考。

description.en: Shrinks the first session-history page so an old session's transcript paints sooner instead of rendering every turn at once.
description.zh: 缩小首次会话历史分页，打开旧会话时更快显示对话内容，而不是一次性渲染全部回合。

description.en: A focused coding agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: intent-first scope, first-principles root-cause fixes, native parallel tool surface, and verified delivery — installed as a hot-pluggable bundle.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的专项编码 Agent 预设：意图对齐、第一性原理根因修复、原生并行工具面与改后实测交付，以组合包形式热插拔安装。

description.en: Personal Academic Think Tank: Research papers are distilled into index cards, complete with verbatim quotes and page references. These feed into a knowledge graph that supports model-based reasoning, the exploration of research topics, and the writing process.
description.zh: 个人学术智库：论文入库总结为卡片，带逐字引句与页码。派生知识图谱供模型推理，研究话题讨论与写作。

description.en: Brings platform.qianwenai.com into DSH: Token Plan and pay-as-you-go providers, a model catalog with pricing, credits and quota readout, and thinking-mode controls. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把 platform.qianwenai.com 接入 DSH：Token Plan 与按量付费双通道、模型目录与定价、Credits 额度查询与思考模式控制。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: OpenCode Go usage panel for DeepSeek Harness: plan quota (rolling 5-hour / weekly / monthly), local token stats, per-model cost, and one-click Go model list refresh. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 OpenCode Go 用量面板：滚动 5 小时 / 每周 / 每月三窗口套餐额度、本地 token 统计、按模型费用，以及一键刷新 Go 模型清单。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A theme-independent floating 1984 Macintosh companion for DeepSeek Harness with animated CRT states, ClaraCore-inspired InnerLife proactive thoughts, Mini DSH sidecar agent, retro CLI Terminal, flip Note Pad, Floppy Disk Markdown/PNG export, Alarm Clock, MacPaint Lite, and Minesweeper.
description.zh: Hello '84（你好 84）：在 DeepSeek Harness 角落养一台活着的 1984 Macintosh，不绑定任何主题，支持多态复古屏保、InnerLife 自主琢磨冒泡、双模 Mini DSH 副脑、复古命令行终端、翻页便签、软盘 Markdown/长图导出、闹钟、MacPaint 与扫雷。

description.en: A local calendar and to-do panel for DSH: day, week and month views over six fixed daily time blocks, goals with two completion models, category boxes, progress and blocker snapshots, append-only progress timelines, notes and collections, spaced-review prompts, a daily exercise prescription, and calendar_read/calendar_write agent tools that only schedule into empty slots. Data stays in a local JSON file with no network calls or telemetry.
description.zh: DSH 的本地日程与待办面板：日、周、月三种视图围着每天六个固定时间块，支持目标拆解、分类盒、进度与卡点快照、只追加的进展时间线、笔记与合集、间隔复习、每日运动处方，以及只往空槽排程的 calendar_read/calendar_write 工具。数据保存在本地 JSON 文件，无网络请求与遥测。

description.en: Tool usage and startup cost: a Plugins-page tab showing which tools your agents call, which ones fail, and how many tokens each tool definition (built-in, plugin or MCP server) adds to every request, with a startup-context chart and plain-language tips on what to drop; a read-only toolbox_report agent tool gives agents the same numbers. Reads dsh session logs locally, no hooks.
description.zh: 工具用量与启动成本：在插件页新增标签，显示智能体调用了哪些工具、哪些经常出错，以及每个工具定义（内置、插件或 MCP 服务器）在每次请求中占用多少 token，附启动上下文图和该关掉哪些工具的通俗建议；只读的 toolbox_report 智能体工具提供同样的数据。在本机读取 dsh 会话日志，无钩子。

description.en: Deletes archived DSH sessions from disk, with a red menu item below Unarchive and a confirm dialog that matches the app. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把已归档的 DSH 会话从磁盘上真正删除；菜单项排在「取消归档」下方并用红字，确认框与应用自身的样式一致。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Play mp4, m4v, webm, ogv and mov files inside the DeepSeek Harness Sidebar document preview with native playback controls, instead of the unsupported-format message.
description.zh: 在侧边栏文档预览里直接播放 mp4、m4v、webm、ogv、mov，替代“该格式文件暂无法预览”。

description.en: A theme-independent retro chrome toaster companion for DeepSeek Harness inspired by 1989 After Dark Flying Toasters — roasts while AI works, pops golden buttered toast on completion, smokes burnt toast on errors, with a 1-5 doneness Pomodoro dial, toast tray Markdown export, and Flying Toasters screensaver mode.
description.zh: DSH Toaster（吐司机）：致敬 1989 After Dark 飞翔烤面包机的独立复古挂件——AI 干活按杆烘烤、完成叮一声弹金黄吐司、卡审批半熟抖动、报错冒黑烟弹焦炭，内置 1~5 档番茄钟、涂黄油收藏装盘导出与全屏放飞彩蛋。

description.en: A local journal for your own price calls: draw the next candles, fill in the actuals when they come due, and see your personal bias profile built only from your own records. No market feed, no auto-fetch, no advice — every number comes from a file you import or a value you confirm.
description.zh: 记录自己的价格判断：画出下一段走势，到期手动填入实际值，偏差按你自己的历史累计成画像。不接行情、不自动取价、不给建议——每个数字都来自你导入的文件或你确认过的输入。

description.en: 前哨 Outpost — a DeepSeek Harness desktop plugin that tracks products daily and writes you a fact-checked morning brief
description.zh: 每天帮你盯住关注的产品，自动核实来源，早上给你一份今日哨报。

description.en: CntokenWorld knowledge base for DeepSeek Harness: sidebar workbench for documents, wiki, link graph and gallery, plus read-only retrieval, read-document and cited Q&A tools. Service address and API key are configured in the plugin settings section.
description.zh: 把 CntokenWorld 知识库接进 DeepSeek Harness，侧边栏看文档、wiki、链接图和图库，还能检索和带引用问答。

description.en: Five code-quality commands for DeepSeek Harness: review and fix, behavior-preserving simplify, secret and path scrubbing, a caption loop with a ledger, and a PUA protocol.
description.zh: 给代码做审查、精简和隐私清理，还能把难任务塞进显式循环里跑，顺手带个 PUA 协议。
给 DeepSeek Harness 补上 DuckDB 查询方法论技能，让 AI 更懂怎么查数据、分析数据。

description.en: 同机信箱：同一台机器上的两只 agent 互相留信、派活、回执——不靠人转手；附一个只读的工单看板。Mailbox for agents on one machine, plus a read-only work-order board.
description.zh: 同一台机器上的两个 agent 能互相留信、派活、回执，不用人转手，还带一个只读工单看板。

description.en: DeepSeekRuntime（DSH）客户端性能诊断插件：静态体检出每个插件在浏览器端的体积与定时器/观察器数量，实时测量帧预算（LoAF 拆成脚本/样式/强制同步布局三段）并归因到具体插件，一键暂停可疑插件做前后对比，导出带实测证据的 Markdown 报告。适配 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 ~ 0.2.x（实测 0.2.2-rc.5），零第三方依赖。
description.zh: 查清是哪个插件拖慢了 DSH 窗口，实时测帧并归因到具体插件，一键暂停对比，还能导出报告。

description.en: 预测卡：在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框上方显示一条虚构的「预测未来」回复 · A fictional prediction reply above the composer for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 输入框上方显示一张虚构的「预测未来」回复卡，给聊天加点趣味。

description.en: Collapsible provider groups in the DSH model picker
description.zh: 把 DSH 模型选择器里的提供商分组折叠起来，列表更清爽，找模型更快。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 研发套件：模式预设、卡片增强、context7、代码格式化与 GitHub Issue 流程（单包合并）
description.zh: 一个插件搞定研发全流程：模式预设、代码格式化、context7 和 GitHub Issue 流水线都在里面。

description.en: Session activity page for DeepSeek Harness: running sessions on top, other sessions by last activity below
description.zh: 在侧边栏按活跃度排列所有会话，运行中的置顶，点一下就能切换过去。

description.en: DSH 侧栏的会话分区插件：可嵌套的显式分组、级联置顶、原生行与菜单兼容、一键切回官方列表。 | Nestable session zones for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧栏会话加可嵌套分区，分组置顶不乱改标题，还能一键切回官方列表。

description.en: 脚本与计划：只看、不乱动的计划任务与脚本面板——列出本机 Windows 计划任务和你指定的目录里的脚本，能手动跑一次、看日志尾巴；不起停、不删除。Scripts & Schedules: a read-only panel for Windows scheduled tasks and your script folders — run one by hand, peek at the log tail.
description.zh: 一眼看清本机有哪些计划任务和脚本，能手动跑一次、看日志尾巴，只看不乱动。

description.en: ReadingSpace DSH — 多格式沉浸阅读 · 三态高亮卡片 · 思维导图 · 快查浮窗与神经语音听书 | Standalone reading & knowledge workspace plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 里一站式搞定读书、批注、查资料、做思维导图和听书，把阅读变成知识创作。

description.en: 把一条真实做过的流程沉淀成窄 skill，并用五道闸判定够不够格发布
description.zh: 把真实做过的流程沉淀成窄 skill，用五道闸卡住质量，够格才让发布。

description.en: Long-term memory, compaction and context observability in one DSH bundle: SQLite recall with hard token budgets, reversible folding, audited governance, and a 7-language panel.
description.zh: 把长期记忆、压缩与上下文观测装进一个 DSH bundle：SQLite 记忆与预算化召回、可逆折叠、带审计链的治理，以及 7 语言面板。

description.en: 大肥鱼 · 音乐管家：绑定 QQ 音乐的 DSH agent preset
description.zh: 绑定 QQ 音乐的音乐搭子，陪你听歌聊天、用大白话整理歌单，还能分析本地音频、生成每周听歌报告。

description.en: Official Dealport CLI, TypeScript SDK, MCP server & Agent Skills — 28M+ US private companies, commercial buildings, cited filings & owner contacts
description.zh: 查美国2800万+私营企业和商业楼宇的工商档案、引用文件与业主联系方式，支持CLI、SDK和MCP接入。

description.en: better vibes during vibe coding: DSH-adapter for async audio.cpp (CPU or GPU) multi-node scheduling of TTS, STT, clone-sample-lib, sfx, music, multi-speaker audio scripts, control by agent or user, digital clock
description.zh: 给 vibe coding 加点氛围：接入 audio.cpp，让 AI 或你随时调度语音合成、识别、克隆、音效和音乐。

description.en: 发散 → 细化 → 动态工作树：把模糊想法拆成可勾选进度的交互式步骤树；一份技能内容，支持 WorkBuddy / Codex / Claude Code / DSH
description.zh: 把模糊想法拆成可勾选进度的交互式步骤树，还能生成自包含 HTML 工作树随时查看。

description.en: Plugin for DeepSeek Harness - gives a new workspace to an old chat. Or moves an old chat to another workspace.
description.zh: 给旧对话换个新工作区，或把旧对话挪到别的工作区，管理起来更方便。

description.en: Adds a DeepSeek provider route that sends a normalized X-Agent-Hint request header and bounded session lifecycle control.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加按请求发送规范化 X-Agent-Hint 头的 DeepSeek 提供方路由，并提供有界的会话生命周期控制。

description.en: Declarative multi-agent workflow engine for DeepSeek Harness — YAML templates, hard budgets, citation anchors, evals.
description.zh: 用 YAML 模板编排多 Agent 工作流，自带预算上限、引用锚点和评测，让复杂任务跑得稳又可控。

description.en: DSH plugin: insert a prepared user/assistant transcript into the open session as real history; generate a draft from a character card.
description.zh: 把写好的对话当作真实历史注入当前会话，也能按角色卡先自动生成草稿再改。

description.en: One-click jump to the DeepSeek Harness session that is waiting for your approval.
description.zh: 一键跳到正在等你审批的会话，焦点直达审批卡片，Enter 通过、Esc 拒绝，不用翻标签页。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a per-session "approve all" switch. 全部同意 — 单会话审批自动放行开关。
description.zh: 给单个会话开个「全部同意」开关，审批请求自动放行，不用一个个点。

description.en: Living ASCII ocean behind the DeepSeek Harness new-session home.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 新会话首页背后放一片会动的 ASCII 海洋，让工作界面更有生气。

description.en: DSH plugin: watches @astryxdesign releases, judges compatibility against its support contract, and self-checks the Astryx MCP server and skill.
description.zh: 装上就能让 AI 像熟手一样用 Astryx 搭前端界面，还会自动盯版本兼容、自检 MCP 服务和技能。
给 AI 助手装上耳朵和眼睛，本地离线做语音转文字、说话人识别和视频理解，隐私不上传。

description.en: Pins a new session in the sidebar when you send its first message.
description.zh: 发第一条消息时自动把新会话固定到侧边栏，空会话不占位，取消后也不会再被固定。

description.en: Cocktail recipe panel for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里查十二款 IBA 经典鸡尾酒配方，带调酒手法和逐步动画演示。

description.en: A validated, interactive GenUI card gallery with Mermaid diagram rendering for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让模型输出经过校验的交互卡片和 Mermaid 图表，在 Harness 里直接看画廊、点着用。

description.en: Blender capability bundle for DeepSeek Harness: headless inspect/run/render tools, a Blender skill, and the plugin market index
description.zh: 让 AI 助手直接检查、运行和渲染 Blender 场景，3D 创作全流程自动化。

description.en: DSH Desktop plugin: pick an element in the built-in browser toolbar and hand its descriptor to the agent.
description.zh: 在内置浏览器工具栏点一下就能选中页面元素，把描述直接交给 AI 助手，省去手动描述。
挂在侧边栏的私人商业人脉工作台，一个联系人一张名片，帮你查资料、记互动、写研究、想下一步。

description.en: Non-destructive Ctrl+F conversation search plugin for DeepSeek Harness (plus userscript & Chrome/Edge MV3 extension)
description.zh: 给 DSH 对话加上不破坏原文的 Ctrl+F 关键词搜索，还附送油猴脚本和浏览器扩展。

description.en: Opens file references from DSH chat at the exact line: click a path to choose the right sidebar or any detected desktop editor, including IntelliJ IDEA, VS Code, Trae, Qoder, CodeBuddy, Sublime Text and Typora. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 聊天里按行打开文件引用：点击路径即可选右侧栏或本机已装编辑器，支持 IntelliJ IDEA、VS Code、Trae、Qoder、CodeBuddy、Sublime Text 与 Typora。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Team agents and group chat for DeepSeek Harness and Seal Harness, with bot collaboration, long-term memory, and file delivery.
description.zh: 让多个 Bot 组队群聊、分工协作，还能记住上下文并互传文件。

description.en: Chemical structure editor plugin for DeepSeek Harness: draw molecules, build from SMILES/molfiles, inspect descriptors, hand structures to the agent.
description.zh: 在侧边栏手绘分子或粘贴 SMILES 生成结构，查看分子式分子量，还能把结构交给 AI 分析。

description.en: Claim ledger for DeepSeek Harness: audits the agent's completion claims against tool output and shows them as a badge.
description.zh: 把 agent 说的「做完了」逐条对上工具输出证据，用三态徽章标出有没有落实，只记录不拦截。

description.en: Docker execution sandbox for DSH with workspace isolation, resource limits, and fair scheduling on Linux and Windows/WSL2.
description.zh: 为 DSH 命令、终端和 Skill 脚本提供 Docker 沙箱，支持工作目录隔离、资源限额及公平调度。

description.en: 把 companion-memory 记忆库搬进 DSH 宿主的一个插件：注入 / 摄入 / 检索 / 恢复。已定档（frozen），作者不再维护。
description.zh: 把 companion-memory 记忆库接进 DSH 宿主，支持注入、摄入、检索和恢复，已定档不再更新。
在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接管理 Cocos Creator 项目，查看场景、资源和构建状态，开发调试更顺手。

description.en: 把 Codex 的 PTC 预设接进 DSH，并修好限定作用域的 WorkBuddy 提示词兼容性。
description.zh: 把 Codex 的 PTC 预设接进 DSH，顺手修好 WorkBuddy 提示词兼容问题。

description.en: Show running, waiting, and completed session counts beside the collapsed sidebar controls, with a quick-jump popover.
description.zh: 折叠侧边栏时直接显示待处理、运行中、已完成等会话数量，点一下还能快速跳转。

description.en: Windows computer-use tools for DeepSeek Harness: UI Automation first, OCR second, screenshots last.
description.zh: 让模型直接操作 Windows 电脑，看屏幕、点按钮、打字、按快捷键，靠结构化接口而不是猜坐标。

description.en: 豆包多账号 —— DSH 插件：自带 doubao-pool provider 与多账号池（扫码收纳、批量测额度、失败自动换号、一键切换）
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上豆包工作 provider 和多账号池，扫码收纳账号、自动测额度、额度用尽自动换号。

description.en: 监控每个会话的实际与预测上下文占用，越界时强制结束回合并停放会话，交给用户处理。
description.zh: 盯着每个会话的上下文占用，快超了自动掐断回合并停放会话，还能一键压缩。

description.en: Composer pill showing the running model's wallet balance, with context occupancy, TTFT/TPS and per-channel quota tabs.
description.zh: 输入框下方的小胶囊，实时显示当前模型的钱包余额、上下文占用和速度，点开还能看各渠道额度明细。

description.en: 把被失败回合吞掉的用户指令补写回会话历史并持久化。
description.zh: 失败回合不再吞掉你刚发的指令，自动补写回会话历史并持久保存。

description.en: Thumbnail readability check for DSH creators.
description.zh: 检查视频封面缩到 512px、320px 后还看不看得清，帮创作者提前避坑。

description.en: A cozy storybook cat wellness buddy plugin for DeepSeek Harness — offers water, guides 20-20-20 eye breaks, stretches & prints thermal wellness receipts right during AI thinking windows.
description.zh: 在 AI 思考的间隙，让手账风萌猫提醒你喝水、做 20-20-20 护眼和拉伸，还能打印健康小票。

description.en: Writing, design and logo workbenches in a single DSH plugin panel
description.zh: 一个侧边栏搞定写作、设计、组件库和 Logo 编辑，内容创作全流程都能在这块面板里完成。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 桌面版生命周期控制：开机自启（设置里一个开关）、状态查询、优雅停止。自启指向 Electron 外壳而不是 Host 子进程，用 .lnk 快捷方式以支持中文路径。
description.zh: 给 DSH 桌面版加个开机自启开关，还能查状态、优雅关掉，自启指向 Electron 外壳不跑偏。

description.en: Cross-device sync for DeepSeek Harness: fish memory, skills, plugin settings, tasks and workspaces. Folder or WebDAV channel, optional AES-256-GCM passphrase, one-click install to DSH Go over USB.
description.zh: 让几台电脑和手机上的 DSH 共用同一份鱼记忆、技能、插件设置和任务，换设备不用重新配。

description.en: 每日日程：每晚按人设和日程类型生成角色第二天的全天日程，联动生图工作室给每段配好穿搭和场景，把日期、时间、此刻在做什么、穿着什么注入对话，角色可以自己查看和临时调整。
description.zh: 每晚给角色排好第二天的全天日程，连穿搭场景一起生成，还能把「此刻在做什么」带进对话。

description.en: Desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: read the Windows UI tree, click controls, type Chinese where paste is blocked
description.zh: 让 AI 在 Windows 桌面上截图、读界面、点控件，还能在禁止粘贴的页面里直接打中文。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness desktop OS integration plugin: native notifications, screenshot to session, clipboard watch, global hotkey. MIT.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接入桌面系统，支持原生通知、截图入会话、剪贴板监听和全局快捷键。

description.en: Receive signed Donetick webhooks and inject them into a DeepSeek Harness conversation as a reminder-style prompt.
description.zh: 接收 Donetick 的签名 Webhook，并以提醒形式注入指定 DSH 会话，让待办事项自动出现在对话里。

description.en: 画界（Xenra DrawWorld）：DSH 画布插件 —— 真画布、结构化图层笔迹、32 支参数化笔刷，模型通过 paint_canvas 在同一份文档上作画
description.zh: 在 DSH 里开一块真画布，模型用 32 支笔刷分层作画，你也能接着改。

description.en: Import DeepSeek web (chat.deepseek.com) conversations into DeepSeek Harness as real, resumable dsh sessions. DSH plugin.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek 网页版的历史对话导入 DSH，变成能接着聊的真实会话。

description.en: 短剧配音交付台：台词本按角色×情绪拆轨，导出保留原始文件名/扩展名/目录结构；默认 dry-run 打印路径，显式 --apply 才落盘，每轨给出时长与响度统计；内置离线占位试听轨 + 外部 TTS 命令引擎。
description.zh: 把短剧台词按角色和情绪拆成配音轨，批量导出还保留原目录结构，先预览再落盘。

description.en: 情绪、记忆与关系，让大肥鱼拥有自己的心
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上 PAD 情绪场和带情感指纹的记忆，让 AI 助手有情绪、记得住、会打分。

description.en: Procedural 3D tree editor for DeepSeek Harness and Seal Harness. Create and edit trees by hand or with an agent, then export GLB, PNG, or JSON.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里手动或让 AI 帮你生成、编辑 3D 树，还能导出 GLB、PNG 或 JSON。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: answer the Windows Open-with list from a warm helper instead of spawning PowerShell per request (~4s -> ~0.02ms).
description.zh: 让 Windows「打开方式」菜单从卡 4 秒变成秒开，装完不用改任何习惯。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: zero-call turn classifier + plan/parallel directive + deterministic context pruning + opt-in pattern reuse
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加速的插件，省掉多余调用、压缩上下文、复用常用模式，让对话跑得更快更省。

description.en: 文件右键菜单秒开：Host 缓存文件关联查询，浏览器侧加超时兜底。
description.zh: 修复文件右键菜单偶发只剩「另存为」的问题，让菜单秒开不再卡顿报错。

description.en: File toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: full-text search (file_search), disk usage report (disk_report), duplicate file finder (find_duplicates). Read-only, zero-dependency, local.
description.zh: 本地文件工具箱：全文搜索、磁盘占用报告、重复文件查找，只读零依赖，找文件清空间都靠它。

description.en: DSH Fish Reader: a quiet local TXT/EPUB novel reader in the DeepSeek Harness composer placeholder.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框的 placeholder 里安静看本地 TXT/EPUB 小说，一点输入就自动让位。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：把用户给出的一句方向拆成互不重叠的分工，派给外部执行体（CLI / MCP / REST）并行执行，看门狗管截止与接管，最后读回真实输出再综合。
description.zh: 把一句话需求拆成互不重叠的分工，派给外部执行体并行干活，看门狗盯截止和接管，最后汇总真实结果。

description.en: Poker and mahjong games inside DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里开两桌练习局：德州单挑带胜率和底池赔率建议，四川麻将带向听数和出牌提示。

description.en: 五平台（Steam/PSN/Switch/Xbox/Epic）游戏记录档案 —— DeepSeek Harness 插件
description.zh: 把 Steam、PSN、Switch、Xbox、Epic 五个平台的游戏记录一键同步成画廊档案，还能评分、写短评、看年度回顾。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: web search that follows each conversation's model route, key and headers, with DeepSeek official-channel handling and keyless Bing fallbacks
description.zh: 让每次对话都按当前所选模型和密钥来联网搜索，没配密钥也能用 Bing 兜底。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin bridging official Gemini Web (4 Neon, Task Mode, PPT/Video local artifacts) to DSH with a lightweight orchestrator — zero reverse proxy, official web quota.
description.zh: 把官方 Gemini 网页版接到 DSH 里，支持多模态对话和 PPT/视频生成，不用逆向代理也不耗额外额度。

description.en: A DSH Plugin which provides a git right side panel similar to the style of VS Code
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里加一个 VS Code 风格的 Git 侧边栏，看改动、管版本更方便。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin embedding the official local Grok Build CLI (ACP) into the native model picker with a graphical Settings console.
description.zh: 把本地 Grok Build CLI 接进 DSH 的模型选择器，还能在图形化设置面板里直接配置，不用手动填 API Key。

description.en: Multi-model bot group chats for DeepSeek Harness: streaming, file tools, real DSH Agent members, and in-room execution logs.
description.zh: 让多个 AI 模型在同一个群里聊天协作，支持流式回复、文件操作和实时执行日志。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：健康打卡、7 天确定性评分、左栏独立界面、模型工具与桌宠播报（原 health-assessment 的插件化版本）
description.zh: 每天健康打卡，7 天确定性打分，左栏独立界面加桌宠播报，帮你记录习惯。

description.en: Infinite canvas for AI image work in DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image, image-to-image, upload, crop, preview and generation history.
description.zh: 在无限画布上玩 AI 生图：文生图、图生图、上传裁剪预览，还能自动保存生成历史。

description.en: DSH 插件：点击输入框图片直接标注编辑（画笔/箭头/矩形/椭圆/序号/马赛克/文字），保存后替换原附件。DeepSeek Harness plugin: annotate composer image attachments before sending.
description.zh: 点一下输入框里的图片就能涂鸦标注，画完直接替换原图再发送，沟通更省事。
